title: Custom Articles Example Page
td: A custom page published with a freely chosen Liquid template, showing how the Custom Articles channel handles arbitrary page templates.

custom_source.note: 任意 *_source 对象都会写成 custom.<key>

html:
Any template, any section

The template name comes from this JSON, so the Custom channel is not tied to a fixed list.

Optional source metafield

Any top-level object ending in _source becomes a custom metafield.

Same content rules still apply

No <h1>, images need alt and title, and third-party links need safe rel tokens.
